newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures mixed but focus on PGMs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures mixed but focus on PGMs.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures ended mixed on Tuesday, with distant months scoring small gains inspired by the London Metal Exchange (LME), where the metal rose to a 22-month high overnight.
"Three months (on the LME) looks set to breach $1,750," said a trader. "But at the moment people here are watching PGMs (platinum group metals)."
The June contract was up 0.4 yen at 206.0 yen and the April added 0.2 yen to 208.0 yen, while nearbys lost between 0.3 yen and 1.5 yen. Estimated volume was 3,677 lots.

On the other hand, most platinum and palladium futures in Tokyo yet again climbed by their daily limits as their physical markets were expected to remain tight despite a resumption of Russian exports.
In London overnight, aluminium kept up its relentless rise, ratcheting up to a 22-month high, while some other metals, including copper, eased on profit-taking and trade selling.
